name: inverted row with bent knee between chairs
description: A home row where you hang under a bar or broom handle set across two chairs, knees bent to make it easier. It trains the back and biceps.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.
